decision: EXP14A g002 (S3): a single RoboDojo episode may run on an official layout k of eval_seed 0 other than layout 0. A contract record reviews layout 0 only; for a one-round, unscheduled episode this table extends a task's record, unchanged, to the listed layouts when its completion layer states no layout-0-specific fact there. A task or layout not listed is refused on any layout but the record's own. Layout schedules of persistent sessions keep the reviewed pools and contract appendices (robodojo-layout-pools-v1.json) and never read this table. v2 (2026-10-10, EXP13A VLA-skill line): the table extends the same records to layouts 5-9, the development layouts of the practice loop on RoboDojo; layouts 0-4 stay the evaluation layouts compared with the EXP14A baseline table.

review.by: layouts 0-4: EXP14A S3 implementation audit (Claude), 2026-10-08; layouts 5-9: EXP13A VLA-skill line audit (Claude), 2026-10-10; human approval pending
review.method: For each listed task: read its registry-v8 completion layer, its upstream gen_instruction at the pinned revision, and the label/category/pose of every Rigid, Dynamic, Articulation, Garment and Geometry instance in layouts 0-9; a layer is portable when every count, side, ordering and fixture it states holds in each listed layout. Layouts 5-9 were checked against each layout-0-4 basis: per-category counts, every instance whose record is identical in layouts 0-4 (identical again in 5-9), and the poses and orderings the basis states (pads and empty pad, cube and cup rows, upright-block sides, tile rows, number-pad row, xylophone yaw, basket and button poses).
review.not_reviewed: Reachability of each layout's objects (the lane's scene smoke measures the scene, not task reach) and the evaluator metadata of objects that only layout k holds: the record's evaluator_dependencies hash layout 0's objects, and layout k's bytes are pinned by the asset revision preflight checks clean.

instruction_sources.fixed: gen_instruction returns one constant template with no placeholder at the pinned revision, so every layout renders the record's instruction; the RunSpec binds it and the worker refuses another.
instruction_sources.layout_readback: the instruction is generated from the layout's objects, so it differs per layout. The RunSpec binds the instruction the lane's scene smoke read back from the official reset of that exact layout (task_instruction in the lane gate's revalidation certificate); the worker refuses a reset whose instruction differs, as for every task.

press_by_number.basis: Buttons keep their poses in layouts 0-9 (red button0 at x -0.15, red button1 at x 0, blue button2 at x +0.15); only the number cards' values change, which the contract reads from the scene.

arrange_largest_number.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold four or five number pieces and as many pads in one row along world X; the contract names neither a count nor a digit.

push_T.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold one T block and one gray T pad at different poses; the contract is relative to the pad and the reset pose.

classify_objects.basis: Layouts 0-9 keep the three baskets at x -0.28, 0 and +0.28 and hold three category groups; the contract names no category.

align_blocks.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold three cubes and the set square at different poses; the contract names no pose.

solve_equation.basis: Layouts 0-9 lay an equation of five or six pads with one empty pad; the contract names no value, symbol or pad count.

stack_blocks_by_language.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold three blocks whose colours give the instruction's order (gen_instruction reads block_0..2 categories), so the instruction differs per layout; the contract defers the order to the instruction.

imitate_sorting_sequence.basis: Layouts 0-9 keep basket0 at (-0.40, -0.15) and basket1 at (+0.35, +0.25), which the contract's 'your basket' and 'the other basket' describe; the five objects differ.

classify_objects_by_language.basis: Layouts 0-9 keep the three baskets at x -0.28, 0 and +0.28; the instruction names each layout's cat0..cat2 categories and differs per layout; the contract defers category-to-basket to the instruction.

play_Xylophone.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold one mallet, its stand and one xylophone at different poses, the xylophone always at yaw 167-180 degrees; the contract's left-to-right order is world -X to +X.

play_tic_tac_toe.basis: Layouts 0-9 are identical in pieces and poses (five rings, four crosses, one board).

stack_blocks.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold three blocks of varying textures; the contract requires no texture order.

stack_bowls.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold three bowls of one model each; the contract names no model or pose.

general_pickup.basis: Layouts 0-9 each hold one labelled target among distractors; the instruction names the layout's target and differs per layout; the contract defers the object and distance to the instruction.

fold_clothes.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold one long-sleeved top at different poses; the contract names no garment model.

match_and_pick_from_conveyor.basis: Layouts 0-9 keep the conveyor and hold a target pair among three distractors; the contract names no object.

cover_blocks.basis: Layouts 0-9 keep the three cubes at x -0.2, 0, +0.2 and the cups in front; only which colour stands where changes, and the contract reads the left-to-right order at reset.

put_bottles_into_dustbin.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold four bottles and keep the dustbin at (-0.63, -0.10), matching the contract's 'all four bottles'.

pour_liquid_into_cup.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold one bottle and one cup (a goblet in layouts 3, 5 and 8); the contract says 'the cup'.

build_tower.basis: Layouts 0-9 keep two upright blocks on each side of world X (block1 and block5 at x < 0, block2 and block6 at x > 0: the contract's two pairs) and the longest board and roof at fixed poses; board sides vary but the contract names none.

pour_balls_into_vase.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold one cup with seven balls and one vase at different poses; the contract names no count.

make_kong.basis: Layouts 0-9 keep the standing row at y -0.15 from x -0.33 to +0.27 and the draw stack at x -0.40 (the contract's left end, world -X); only tile faces change.

insert_tubes.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold three tubes and one rack, matching 'all three tubes'.

store_laptop_and_headphones.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold the same five objects (headset model varies) at nearby poses; the headphone orientation clause is relative to the reset pose.

sort_nesting_dolls_by_size.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold five dolls, matching the contract.

fill_pen_holder.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold four pens (pen or oil_pen) and one holder, matching 'all four pens'.

deposit_coin.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold one coin on its stand and one coin bank at different poses.

organize_table.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold the same object set (models vary); the alignment clauses are relative to the reset pose.

make_toast.basis: Layouts 0-9 hold four slices in the rack and one toaster, matching the contract.
